items.title: WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels
items.summary: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. items.summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) describes a system that improves not only its behavior but also the process by which it improves. items.summary: Large language models need effective ways to acquire and use external knowledge beyond what they retain from pretraining.
